name: Tuscany, Italy

rent.notes: Immobiliare.it Oct 2026 asking rents: Tuscany EUR 17.34/m2/mo (+7.9% y/y), Firenze 20.14, Lucca 17.33, Grosseto 17.82, Pisa 12.39, Siena 11.53, Arezzo 9.06; a 90-100 m2 pet-friendly 2-3BR runs ~EUR 1,000 in Siena/Arezzo to ~1,500-1,900 around Florence/Lucca (Numbeo Florence 3BR outside centre EUR 1,471).

healthcare.system: Italian SSN. Excellent hospitals in Florence (AOU Careggi) accessible from most Tuscan towns. Good specialist care.
healthcare.waitTimes: Public: 3-10 weeks. Private clinics widely available.
healthcare.prescriptionCoverage: SSN covers essential prescriptions with tiered co-pays

pros.text: Iconic rolling hills, vineyards, and Renaissance culture (Tuscany hosts 5 UNESCO World Heritage sites: Florence, Siena, Pienza, San Gimignano, Val d'Orcia)
